description: This file defines geometric operations related to line segments, including creation, rotation, intersection detection, distance calculation, and utility functions for line segments in 2D space.

methods.name: lineSegment
methods.description: Creates a line segment from two points.

methods.name: isLineSegment
methods.description: Type guard to check if an unknown segment is a valid line segment.

methods.name: lineSegmentRotate
methods.description: Rotates a line segment around an origin point by a given angle in radians.

methods.name: segmentsIntersectAt
methods.description: Calculates the intersection point of two line segments, if it exists.

methods.name: pointOnLineSegment
methods.description: Checks if a point lies on a line segment within a threshold.

methods.name: distanceToLineSegment
methods.description: Calculates the shortest distance from a point to a line segment.

methods.name: lineSegmentIntersectionPoints
methods.description: Returns the intersection point of two line segments if they intersect.

methods.name: lineSegmentsDistance
methods.description: Calculates the minimum distance between two line segments.
